patch_description:
The performance metrics of the previous programs indicate that simplicity and trade frequency are currently the primary drivers of the combined score. The highest-performing seed (80.50) used a simple threshold of 0.002 with no microstructure filters and fixed exits. 

The current program (54.16) has a higher profit factor (20.08 vs 16.55) but significantly fewer trades (252 vs 462) due to restrictive microstructure and funding filters. This edit aims to maximize the combined score by:
1. Lowering the entry thresholds slightly (0.0019) and relaxing the microstructure/funding filters to increase trade frequency.
2. Standardizing the position size to 0.11 (slightly higher than the 0.10 seed) to boost total return.
3. Adopting the fixed 0.004/0.003 take-profit and stop-loss targets from the high-performing seed, as they appear more robust in this timeframe.
4. Fixing the max_bars to 4 for consistency.
